findings.evidenceJa: 夜の深さは丑三つ時のそれだった
findings.governingReading: the depth of night is like that of the dead-of-night period around two in the morning
findings.explanation: The comparison makes ten o’clock feel only like midnight, substantially weakening the unnatural depth of night.

findings.governingReading: the continuing series of coma incidents
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds that the comas are unexplained while omitting their serial incident framing.

findings.governingReading: the town after the curtain of night has fallen
findings.explanation: The theatrical image of night descending over the town disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 外には人影さえ見られない
findings.governingReading: not even a human figure can be seen outside
findings.explanation: A visual claim limited to what can be seen becomes a broader assertion about nobody walking outside.

findings.governingReading: patrol the town blindly or without a lead
findings.explanation: The town-wide patrol objective is reduced to generic wandering.
